pages.title: What this unit is about
pages.body:
> 📝 **Strand 2 — Productivity Software**
Sub-strand 2: Introduction to Presentation

Pictures and diagrams make presentations memorable. In this unit you will add and edit images, screenshots and photo albums, draw and arrange shapes, use SmartArt, and present a visual project.

pages.title: Content standard and lessons
pages.body:
> 🎯 **Content standard**
- **B8.2.2.1** Demonstrate how to use Microsoft PowerPoint (Multimedia).

> 🧭 **What you will be able to do**
- **B8.2.2.1.1** Demonstrate how to add pictures and screenshots, and edit and format pictures.
- **B8.2.2.1.2** Demonstrate how to add a drawing canvas and shapes, and edit, format and add text to shapes.
- **B8.2.2.1.3** Demonstrate how to add text to shapes and arrange shapes.

> 🗺️ **Lessons in this unit**
- 5.1 Pictures, ClipArt, Photo Album and Screenshots
- 5.2 Shapes, SmartArt and Grouping
- 5.3 Adding Text to Shapes and Arranging Shapes

**Core competencies developed:** Digital Literacy (DL5.1), Creativity and Innovation (CI5.4), Communication and Collaboration (CC9.6).

pages.title: Pictures, ClipArt, Photo Album and Screenshots
pages.body:
Curriculum indicator B8.2.2.1.1
> 🎯 **Learning objectives** By the end of this lesson you should be able to:
- use the Images group on the Insert tab;
- insert pictures, screenshots and photo albums;
- edit and format pictures.
| **Command (Insert › Images)** | **What it does** |
|---|---|
| Pictures › This Device | Insert a photo or image saved on your computer |
| Pictures › Stock Images | Royalty-free photos, icons, cut-out people and illustrations supplied with Microsoft 365 |
| Pictures › Online Pictures | Search the web (Bing) for images; tick **Creative Commons only** and check licences |
| Screenshot | Insert a picture of any open window, or **Screen Clipping** to capture part of the screen |
| Photo Album | Create a new presentation from many photos at once, with captions and layouts (PowerPoint for Windows) |
> ⏳ **Then and now — WHAT YOU WILL SEE TODAY What happened to ClipArt?** Older versions of Office had a **ClipArt** gallery of cartoon-style images. Microsoft removed it in Office 2013 and later versions. The modern equivalents are **Insert › Icons**, **Stock Images** and **Online Pictures**.
> 🪜 **Step by step — Creating a photo album**
1. Click **Insert › Photo Album › New Photo Album**.
2. Click **File/Disk…**, select several photos (hold Ctrl) and click **Insert**.
3. Use the arrows to reorder pictures; choose **Picture layout** (e.g. 2 pictures with title) and **Frame shape**.
4. Tick **Captions below ALL pictures** if needed, choose a **Theme**, then click **Create**.

pages.title: Editing and formatting pictures
pages.body:
## Editing and formatting pictures
Click a picture to show the **Picture Format** tab:
| **Tool** | **Use** |
|---|---|
| Crop | Cut away unwanted edges; crop to a shape or aspect ratio |
| Remove Background | Delete the background around the main subject |
| Corrections | Sharpen, soften, brightness and contrast |
| Colour / Artistic Effects | Recolour, saturation, sketch or painting effects |
| Picture Styles | Frames, shadows, reflections and 3D rotation |
| Picture Border | Line around the picture |
| Size and Rotate | Exact height and width; rotate or flip |
| Compress Pictures | Reduce file size |
| Alt Text | A description for screen readers (accessibility) |

pages.title: Shapes, SmartArt and Grouping
pages.body:
Curriculum indicator B8.2.2.1.2
> 🎯 **Learning objectives** By the end of this lesson you should be able to:
- use the Illustrations group;
- insert and format shapes and SmartArt;
- group shapes together.
> 🪜 **Step by step — Drawing shapes**
1. Click **Insert › Illustrations › Shapes** and choose a shape (rectangle, arrow, star, flowchart symbol).
2. Drag on the slide to draw it. Hold **Shift** while dragging for a perfect square or circle.
3. Drag the yellow handle to change its form, the circular arrow to rotate it, and the white handles to resize it.
**SmartArt** turns text into professional diagrams such as lists, processes, cycles, hierarchies (organisation charts) and pyramids. Click **Insert › SmartArt**, choose a layout, and type in the **Text Pane**. Use **SmartArt Design** to change colours and styles. You can also select a bulleted list and click **Home › Convert to SmartArt**.
## The drawing canvas and grouping
A **drawing canvas** is a frame that holds several shapes together so that they move and resize as one drawing. In **Word**, insert one with **Insert › Shapes › New Drawing Canvas**. **PowerPoint** has no drawing canvas; instead you **group** shapes: select them (hold **Shift** and click each, or drag a box around them) and press **Ctrl + G** (or **Shape Format › Group**). **Ctrl + Shift + G** ungroups them.

pages.title: Adding Text to Shapes and Arranging Shapes
pages.body:
Curriculum indicator B8.2.2.1.3
> 🎯 **Learning objectives** By the end of this lesson you should be able to:
- use the Shape Format ribbon;
- add and format text in shapes;
- arrange, align and layer shapes; present a project.
To add text, simply click a shape and start typing (or right-click › **Edit Text**). Select a shape to show the **Shape Format** ribbon:
| **Group** | **Commands** |
|---|---|
| Insert Shapes | Edit Shape (change shape, edit points), Text Box |
| Shape Styles | Preset styles, **Shape Fill**, **Shape Outline**, **Shape Effects** (shadow, glow, bevel) |
| WordArt Styles | Text Fill, Text Outline, Text Effects for the text inside shapes |
| Arrange | **Bring Forward / Send Backward** (layering), **Align** (left, centre, distribute evenly), **Group**, **Rotate**, Selection Pane |
| Size | Exact height and width |
> 💻 **Practical session — Present a visual project**
In groups, prepare a 6-slide presentation on **“The Water Cycle”** or **“How Mobile Money Works”**. Include: a photo with a border and corrected brightness, a screenshot of a relevant website, a SmartArt cycle or process diagram, and a diagram you build from shapes with text, aligned and grouped. Present it to the class.

pages.body:
> ✏️ **Review exercises** — answer these in your exercise book or on the computer, then check with your teacher.
## Short answer questions
1. Describe how to insert a screenshot into a slide.
2. List **five** picture formatting tools and their uses.
3. Explain the purpose of grouping shapes.
4. What is SmartArt? Give **three** types of SmartArt graphic.
